title: Savannah Chrisley is pregnant, expecting first child with fiancé - USA Today
description: Reality TV star Savannah Chrisley is pregnant with her first child. She also announced her engagement.

title: One week until midterms, Trump takes campaign blitz to Texas - Fox News
description: One week before Election Day, President Donald Trump will rally in Texas as Republicans fight to hold Congress and the DOJ pursues a new case against James Comey.

title: Norway and Finland hold rare call with Putin to discuss ending war - BBC
description: An end to the conflict in Ukraine "will not be achieved through silence," Finland's President Alexander Stubb said.

title: Trump administration can block immigration judges from closing deportation cases - The Washington Post
description: The Trump administration objected to the Biden-era practice, saying it was a form of backdoor amnesty. Immigration advocates called it a useful tool to protect migrants seeking refuge.
